description: This file contains implementation of code generation and memory management routines for tensor expressions in PyTorch JIT, including buffer allocation, reuse, and external call handling.

classes.name: CodeGen
classes.description: Handles code generation, buffer argument processing, and memory allocation for tensor expressions.

classes.name: RegisterCodeGenList
classes.description: Singleton registry for code generation strategies identified by name.

classes.name: GenericIntrinsicsExpander
classes.description: Mutator for expanding intrinsic functions like sigmoid in tensor expressions.

classes.name: ExtCallMemoryReuse
classes.description: Manages external call rewriting and memory reuse for buffers during code generation.

methods.name: CodeGen::argToPtr
methods.description: Converts a buffer argument to a pointer based on its type.

methods.name: CodeGen::call_with_numel
methods.description: Stub method indicating unimplemented functionality for calling with number of elements.

methods.name: ExtCallMemoryReuse::mutate
methods.description: Rewrites external call nodes to reuse memory buffers when possible.

methods.name: CodeGen::allocIntermediateBufs
methods.description: Allocates or reuses intermediate buffers based on liveness analysis.
